title: Jellyfish Lake, size comparison of Mastigias sp. papua etpisoni.jpg
author: Lukas

description: Representative of the jellyfish species Mastigias sp. papua etpisoni of Jellyfish Lake, Palau. While jellies seen in the lake range in size from small berries to melons, most are about the size of an orange.
